name: web-onboarding-dialog-with-dark-image-header-page-dots-and-skip-next
title: White onboarding modal on black with a dark image area holding a grey 3D ring, a heading, description, four page dots and Skip and Next buttons
whatItIs: A white rounded dialog on black with a dark charcoal image at the top showing a soft grey donut with faint vertical lines and a close x, a bold title 'Welcome to Origin UI', a grey description, four page dots at the left and a bordered Skip and a black Next with an arrow at the right.
whatItMeans: Polished and friendly; a hero image and clear navigation make a tour feel light.
techniques: Put a hero image above the copy.
Pair outlined Skip with black Next.

vocabulary.definition: A picture area at the top of a card.
A secondary and primary navigation pair.
